channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ronnie Price | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ronnie Price from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Byron Scott on Ronnie Price
item.description:
Mark Medina:Byron Scott on Ronnie Price:

“He looked like he had a fight with Ali in the 80’s”

Byron Scott on Ronnie Price, Jan 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Ronnie Price
item.description:
“We’re excited to welcome Ronnie (Price) and his family to the Magic organization,”

Rob Hennigan on Ronnie Price, Jul 25, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Ronnie Price
item.description:
“Ronnie gives us a different look in the backcourt and we feel he'll be a nice complement to the players we have in place,”

Neil Olshey on Ronnie Price, Jul 18, 2012. Source: NBA.com.
